ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; surface is dominated by low-intensity dark-gray/black pixels (estimated >92%) with sparse, high-intensity white pixel clusters (estimated <8%) localized to scars and scratches.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly a contiguous solid dark field. Distinct high-contrast features include approximately 8-10 white circular rings (rosettes) scattered across the mid-section of both lobes and a cluster of white linear markings on the left lobe mid-region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior angle (estimated 40-45 degrees); vertex depth is high relative to the horizontal width of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged peak-to-valley amplitude at the distal tips; right lobe tip exhibits a deep concave notch roughly 10% of total lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips; curve is significantly degraded by edge serration and terminal erosions.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple high-contrast white rings; cluster of 5-6 rings on the left lobe (medial to distal) and 3-4 rings on the right lobe medial region, characteristic of previous barnacle attachments.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct horizontal and one diagonal (approx. 45-degree angle) white linear pixel disruptions located on the left lobe mid-section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant non-symmetrical erosion and jagged tissue loss at the distal tips of both lobes; right lobe tip shows a pronounced missing semi-circular segment.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast circular 'donut' scarring pattern distributed widely across the dark ventral surface.
